items.title: Donate to Support EMU Students and Fight Food Insecurity Through Motor City MACtion
items.summary: As Eastern Michigan University prepares to face Central Michigan University in Motor City MACtion, the Eagles are calling on fans, alumni, and supporters to turn rivalry pride into meaningful community impact by donating to Swoop's Pantry.

items.title: Football Set for Road Showdown at Ohio
items.summary: The Eastern Michigan University football team hits the road this week for its final Saturday contest of the 2026 regular season as the Eagles will look to bounce back from a Homecoming loss when they visit the University of Ohio, Oct. 24, inside Peden Stadium in Athens, Ohio.

items.title: Eastern Falls on Homecoming to Toledo
items.summary: The Eastern Michigan University football team suffered a 34-14 Homecoming defeat to the University of Toledo, Oct. 17, inside Rynearson Stadium, ending its three-game Mid-American Conference winning streak. items.title: Know Before You Go: Eastern Michigan Hosts Toledo for Homecoming
items.summary: Eastern Michigan University Football returns to The Factory Saturday, Oct. 17, when the Eagles host the University of Toledo for Homecoming at 3:30 p.m. inside Rynearson Stadium.

items.title: EMU Hosts Toledo for Homecoming Game
items.summary: The Eastern Michigan University football team will look to extend its winning streak to four while capturing a Homecoming victory for the sixth consecutive year this weekend as the Eagles are set to play host to the University of Toledo Saturday, Oct. 17, inside 'The Factory' at Rynearson Stadium in Ypsilanti.
